note: Untested in a full run: the first recipe sized for one 16 GB GPU (RTX 5080 Laptop), 102M parameters with 32K-token windows, trained with --recompute --micro-batch 1. Layer 4 is DeepSeek-V4's CSA (8 heads of 128 sharing one key-value head, an indexer of 8 heads of 128 and top 64, V4-Flash's scaled to the width), layer 8 is HCA, and the MTP block's attention is a 128-token window. With --recompute on an integrated Radeon 860M, one window of random tokens peaked at 1.9 GiB at 4K tokens, 2.8 GiB at 8K, 4.6 GiB at 16K and 8.2 GiB at 32K; docs/training.md has the table. Its data is the classics for now (about 4.3M tokens, so the model mostly memorizes); it changes once a larger mixture exists. Its training is one stage: 300 steps of 8 windows of 32K tokens; DeepSeek-V4's stages to 1M tokens (4K, 16K, 64K, 1M) are not set yet, since their steps and batches are the recipe's to choose. A GPU where 32K tokens do not fit trains it the same with --segment 8192 or --strategy split (docs/training.md, "Long windows").
